reviews.text: Excellent clinic with exceptional staff who are attentive, through, and compassionate. I highly recommend Castle West!
Been trusting my animals to this clinic for over 20 years.
Magnificent people, service, and care.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! Our team is delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

Dr Bill McGehee was very knowledgeable and experienced with my 8 yr old rabbit. He’s also nutritionally knowledgeable in what types of veggies and natural herbs help animals, unlike most vets who just shove steroids and multiple prescriptions in your face. He was awesome. My bunny had developed Snuffles and he had shown me how to administer the antibiotic.
We have been going here for at least 13 plus yrs for the parrots and dogs. Great place love the people there. Thanks guys for the great service.
The usual excellent professional service. The Docs and staff are the best. They take their time to answer questions and make sure everything is perfect.

Love both Dr. Evan and Dr. McGehee! I’ve been taking my dog there for a little over a year and have always had a great experience. I recently moved about 20 minutes away from the clinic but we still make the drive cause they’re worth it!
Our first time and we are so thankful to finally find a vet that we can trust!!

Just wanted to thank this clinic for how it helped us with our dog in the last few years of her life. They always pointed us in the right direction and never overcharged for things. On my dogs last day, although they were busy, they were able to fit in an appointment the same day to look at her and give us a peaceful goodbye to our pup. Shout out to Dr Even McGehee for being so kind and empathetic during this hard final appointment. I know it must be tough to be there with a family going thru a tough moment but you were there and were very kind thru the whole experience. So just wanted to say thank you to the whole clinic and we highly recommend them to anyone. Thanks again for giving us a peaceful goodbye to our loved one

This place is amazing! I brought my old girl here to establish her new vet and the staff was amazing. From the doctor explaining everything he was doing and giving plenty of advice to the technicians who listened well to my concerns and were very patient and kind with my dog during her nail trim. Vets are a scary place for my dog, but the staff was perfect and I am glad I found this clinic.
I think that Dr Bill McGehee is an excellent Veterinarian He always have diagnosed my two cats Luna and Conchita correctly. Thank you Dr.  McGehee
The McGehee’s have been taking great care of my dogs for over 30 years! I’m blessed to have such great vets!
Best staff ever!  Dr Bill is one of the best I know!
We are grateful for your support, Michael! Please reach out anytime we can be there for you.
Thanks so much for your support, Tracy! Please let us know whenever we may be of assistance.
Darryl, receiving a 5-star rating from you means a lot to us! We look forward to continuing to meet your pet care needs with excellence.

They were very instrumental in helping our beloved white cat Steve during a time when he needed them the most! We are all very grateful for the kindness and care we received from Dr. Evan and all his vet techs!
Great friendly service 😄 …
Best exotic bird vet.  Always caring and he has saved many of my birds.  I completely trust and admire his knowledge and expertise.

There are not enough stars in this system to give this team. Every single member of staff (including Kharen the clinic cat) are so wonderful at what they do and just who they are as people.

I've brought my cats in to see both Dr. Bill and Dr. Evan many many times, Egg especially, who at many times we thought would be his final visit to the vet.

My last visit was a drop off for my cats annuals, including Egg. Pretty mundane stuff. But it occurred to me that without the Staff at Castle West Animal Hospital I wouldn't be doing this mundane visit with Egg. I wouldn't have Egg at all.

I feel lucky to take my cats to a clinic with such a reliable, knowledgeable, compassionate and sweet group of people. From the little ringworm scares to the hard quality of life talks, I'm grateful for every visit I have with them.

Thank you again to the team for everything they've ever done for me and my cats and for the many future visits we'll have. I'll continue to recommend them to everyone!
Jackie, we're thrilled to receive your 5-star rating! Your support means a lot to our team, and we're here whenever you need us.

Staff is very nice and friendly.
Services are very reasonable.
Love this place.  Only vet we trust with our babies!

I have been going to Cadtle West for over 30 years. They are so great to deal with - professional, and caring. Everyone there is so helpful and compassionate, knowledgeable and thorough. I am so grateful for their help, and will not go to another animal clinic.
An animal hospital but only by appointments. They don't take emergency vet visit. Very disappointing.
Dr Evan was fantastic. Helped us in a very rough time with our pet Molly.

Dr. McGeeHee has been my animal's veterinarian for over 20 years. I have always been satisfied with the treatment of my pets and Dr.'s McGeeHee bedside manner no matter the reason for the visit. They are there to help out and explain the issue and plain terms that are easily understood. I have and will continue to recommend Castle West Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinarian for their pets.

I took my cat pancake here for a check up and to get spayed. The vet was obviously not a cat lover. He almost did not want to touch my poor cat who was very clean and smelled good. Vet treated my cat like she was some dirty creature. I can almost hear the vet saying ewww in his head.  My poor baby cat died 3 months after her surgery. They did not give a follow up call. They did not thoroughly check her before doing the surgery. I think they hate cats here. I would not take my cats here again. Theres other clinics with real reviews. Instead of this 4.8 fake review. I would take my bussiness somewhere else where they actually love and care for cats.

Why would I need to contact you? That is not going to bring my furbaby back. What you need to do is do follow up care on all procedures that you do. Whether it be a simple one or complex one. You obviously lack that because you never called me and followed up with me after the her procedure. I was a new furparent. I was not educated by your vet on what to do on what red flags to watch for. On what vaccinations to do monthly... You didnt care.

I could not be more grateful for this veterinary clinic, I brought my senior baby sharon in with the worst fear in my heart due to her cancer and Dr Evan was so patient and extremely caring and knowledgeable. He helped Sharon go from night to day with help of medication for her arthritis, I’m so grateful that she can spend the rest of her life as comfortable as possible. The same with my mom’s senior dog Chloe, thanks to the team of techs and Dr Evan. He asks what about my opinion and my expectations concerning our babies with their health and their best interest in mind and helps in the best way. I couldn’t be more grateful for the them. Thank you very much
Marilee, thank you for rating our services with five stars! We're delighted to know that your experience met your expectations, and we appreciate your support.

Loved the experience. We have been shopping around for a new Vet. This is a great place. The techs were super friendly and gentle with our pets, and the Dr was great too. They wanted to care for the animals but didn't push a bunch of treatments that were pricey and unnecessary.

Can't say enough about how friendly and inviting everyone is here. We have 5 animals and will never go anywhere else!
Love the vets and Great assistants with pets.

My family has been going to Dr. McGeehe Sr for decades, and now I have his son to thank for taking care of my latest pup. They are very knowledgeable and fantastic at affordable prices for routine visits. The only downside is they don't do payment plans for the more expensive care like surgery, sterilization, etc. But, it's usually less expensive overall than the vets that do offer payment plans.
Thank You for taking care of our pets with love, expertise and professionalism!!

Dr. Evan McGehee was very patient and compassionate in treating my senior male cat, Gray. He is an excellent veterinarian and thoroughly explained what he was doing to diagnose my cat's medical issues. The other staff members, technicians and clerks who assisted in doing ancillary procedures such as drawing blood, running tests, and doing other types of pet care (nail trim) are also highly qualified and helpful in keeping things on schedule and pet parents informed. Thank you Castle West for taking care of my fur babies for over 30 years.

Small, efficient, friendly. The vet is knowledgeable, accommodating and friendly. The staff and techs are capable and friendly. Made a return visit today, 11/27/2024. Still impressed with the vet, techs and clinic over all.
The doctor and staff were very kind. They were very accommodating to my request.

Update 11-2024 I need to give them 10 stars ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ Seriously I've been going almost weekly with a foster Great Pyrenees for 4 months and Dr. Evan McGeHee & the entire staff have just been amazing! I can't imagine a better vet to work with, willing to listen to my ideas and concerns and find solutions with us not just for us. I appreciate so much the respect and professionalism of Dr. Evan McGeHee! Bestest Veterinarian ever‼️

June 2024 - I foster cats & dogs, and see lots of different Vets. Castle West is by far the best. Every member of the staff is kind, helpful & friendly. Every one of the vets (3) different ones so far I've seen are knowledgeable and take enough time to explain and answer questions.
Hands down the best vet in the area! Help my baby get relief right away from severe itching. Highly recommend. Thank you so much.
Many of the staff members are really nice.  Reasonably priced for their services.  Vets are competent and are open to alternative health care for my pets.  Thank you folks.
Thank you, Walter, for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to have your support and look forward to continuing to care for your pet.
Somewhat expensive but the pet services are thorough and effective.  Very nice customer service.
Excellent Family Vet..been here almost 20 years always took care of our furry family.
The staff is amazing. Dr. Evan was so patient with our Jack and got him the right treatment. The rest of the staff are so kind and I would highly recommend them to everyone.
Erika, your 5-star rating speaks volumes! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us, and we're here anytime you need us.

I love this place! They take very good care of all four of my rabbits. They have spayed and neutered all of them. Very reasonably priced and knowledgeable. Highly recommend bringing all your fur babies here!
I love all the employees and the vet at this office. We have gone here for years. Highly recommended.

I’m so glad I found castle west animal hospital. Doctor McGee is so compassionate and knowledgeable. Staff is friendly and helpful, and the cost of care is affordable. I would highly recommend this facility to anyone!!!!

10/09/23  Took our baby girl, Boo, for her yearly exam and vaccines today, and I couldn’t be happier.  Dr. E. McGehee and the staff were very friendly and thoroughly examined her.  He even examined her paw pads due to injuries she sustained chasing squirrels over the weekend.  I am very satisfied with the care and attention they always provide for her, and I greatly appreciate the advice and recommendations given to me throughout this year of me bringing her here.  Thank you to both, Dr. E. McGehee and Dr. B. McGehee and staff, y’all are awesome!

9/09/24 Brought our girl, Boo, in to have her eye checked for allergies, 4DX, and vaccines.  I mentioned she made herself bleed with all the scratching, and they were kind enough to trim her nails as well.  They are absolutely fantastic here.  Thank you. Dr. E. McGehee and staff for taking such good care of Boo today.
